name: FashionPix – AI Product Photos for WooCommerce
author: fashionpix

sections.description:
Please read before installing: the admin screens of this plugin are in Dutch.
The product texts it writes are available in four languages — Dutch, English,
German and French.

You photograph one garment with your phone. FashionPix turns that into model
shots — your own, real item on a model, not redrawn — plus a flat-lay,
close-ups and the texts a product page needs.

This plugin fetches that result and puts it into WooCommerce.

What ends up in your product

  • The model shots and the flat-lay, as the product gallery
  • Meta title and meta description
  • The short and the long product description
  • Alt text for every image — required under the European Accessibility Act
  • The fit information that brings returns down (“the model is 1.78 m and
    wears a size M”)
  • Brand, size, material and washing instructions, where these were read from
    the label

All of it in four languages: Dutch, English, German and French. You choose per
product which language to fill in.

Your product never goes live on its own

The product is created as a draft. You set the price and the stock and you
press publish yourself. If you would rather not work that way, the settings
let you choose to publish straight away; that option is off by default. The
plugin publishes nothing, deletes nothing and changes nothing about existing
products other than the one you point it at.

What you need

This plugin is free and complete. It has no premium version, no licence key,
no trial period and no paid add-ons, and it does not lock, limit or hide any
of its own features.

To fill a product with images and texts, the plugin fetches them from
FashionPix — a separate external service, run by us, at fashionpix.nl. That
service is not part of this plugin: you sign up for it yourself, you have your
own account there, and creating images there is paid for in credits under that
service’s own terms. The plugin itself charges nothing and handles no payments.

Where your data goes

The plugin talks only to the FashionPix API at fashionpix.nl, and only when
you press a button. Nothing about your visitors or your orders is sent — the
plugin does not touch orders. What is sent is your connection token and the ID
of the shoot you are fetching.

Terms: https://fashionpix.nl/voorwaarden
Privacy: https://fashionpix.nl/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through Plugins → Add New Plugin, or upload the folder
    fashionpix-ai-product-photos-for-woocommerce to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. In wp-admin, go to the FashionPix menu.
  4. Paste your connection token. You create one in the FashionPix app under
    “My webshops”; with a new account there is already one waiting for you.
  5. Click Test connection.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

You do, for filling in products. Without WooCommerce the settings page still
works, but the panel on the product screen does not appear.

Does the plugin publish products by itself?

Not by default: everything arrives as a draft, and you decide the price, the
stock and the moment of publishing. There is one setting that switches this to
publishing straight away — it stays off unless you turn it on yourself.

Does it change existing products?

Only the product you have open at that moment, and only when you click “Fill
this product”.

Does the plugin cost money?

No. The plugin is free, and every part of it is free: there is no paid
version, no licence key and no feature held back behind a payment.

Creating images does cost money, but not here — that happens at FashionPix, a
separate external service you have your own account for, where images are paid
for in credits. This plugin only fetches a finished result and charges nothing
for doing so.

Does it also work without this plugin?

Yes. In the FashionPix app you can download a file for every shoot containing
all the photos and texts, and put those into your shop by hand. The plugin
saves you that work.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • Renamed all internal prefixes from fpx to fpix so they are at least four
    characters long, as the plugin directory guidelines require. Your connection
    token and settings carry over automatically.
  • Declares Requires Plugins: woocommerce, so WordPress checks for WooCommerce
    before activating.
  • “Tested up to” is now declared only in readme.txt, not in the plugin header.

1.3.0

  • Works with the new FashionPix studio: model shots, flat-lay and close-ups
    from a single shoot.
  • Declares compatibility with the WooCommerce order tables (HPOS), so
    WooCommerce no longer shows a warning about it.
  • Texts brought up to date with the current product.

1.2.1

  • Various improvements to the product panel.

1.0.0

  • First release: settings, connection test and filling in a product from a
    completed shoot.
